question: Which government-owned organisation is primarily responsible for electricity transmission in India? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (08/09/2025) Shift 3)
options: National Thermal Power Corporation Limited
Central Electricity Authority
Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited
Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Power Grid Corporation of India Limited

Explanation:
The primary responsibility for electricity transmission in India lies with Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID). It is a Central Public Sector Undertaking (CPSU) under the Ministry of Power, Government of India. Established in 1989, it operates and maintains the inter-state and inter-regional transmission system across the country. POWERGRID manages over 50% of India's total installed transmission capacity and operates the National Grid, which connects five regional grids, enabling efficient power exchange. The company is responsible for developing high-voltage transmission lines, substations, and associated infrastructure. It plays a crucial role in ensuring reliable and stable power supply across states.

question: What is the mandated time for the Public Information Officer (PIO) to provide information?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (09/09/2025) Shift 1)
options: 15 days for urgent matters
60 days for all cases
30 days generally and 48 hours for life or liberty cases
10 days for personal requests
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 30 days generally and 48 hours for life or liberty cases

Explanation:
Under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005, the Public Information Officer (PIO) is mandated to provide information within a specified time frame. For general requests, the time limit is 30 days from the receipt of the application. However, if the information pertains to life or liberty of a person, the time limit is reduced to 48 hours. This provision ensures that urgent cases receive prompt attention. It is important to note that if the information is to be transferred to another public authority, additional time may be allowed, but the total period should not exceed 30 days. Thus, the correct mandated time is 30 days generally and 48 hours for life or liberty matters.

question_hi: पब्लिक इनफार्मेशन अफसर (PIO) को जानकारी प्रदान करने के लिए अनिवार्य समय क्या है? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (09/09/2025) Shift 1)

Explanation:
सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम (RTI Act), 2005 के तहत पब्लिक इनफार्मेशन अफसर (PIO) को जानकारी प्रदान करने के लिए निर्धारित समय सीमा सामान्य मामलों में 30 दिन है। यदि जानकारी जीवन या स्वतंत्रता से संबंधित है, तो यह अवधि घटकर 48 घंटे रह जाती है। यह प्रावधान नागरिकों को त्वरित और समय पर सूचना सुनिश्चित करने के लिए बनाया गया है। ध्यान देने योग्य बात यह है कि यदि जानकारी किसी दूसरे कार्यालय से प्राप्त करनी होती है, तो अतिरिक्त समय दिया जा सकता है, लेकिन कुल समय सीमा 30 दिनों से अधिक नहीं होती। इस प्रकार, PIO को सामान्यतः 30 दिन और संवेदनशील मामलों में 48 घंटे में जानकारी उपलब्ध करानी होती है।

question: Which of the following statements about the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) is correct?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (09/09/2025) Shift 1)
options: It guarantees minimum support prices for rural produce.
It aims to organise rural poor into Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
It offers 100 days of guaranteed employment to rural poor
It provides direct employment in rural public sector units.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It aims to organise rural poor into Self-Help Groups (SHGs).

Explanation:
The National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM), also known as Ajeevika, is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development. Its primary objective is to organise the rural poor into Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and provide them with sustainable livelihood opportunities. The mission focuses on increasing income and improving the financial status of poor households. Under NRLM, community institutions such as SHGs, village organisations, and cluster-level federations are formed. The mission places special emphasis on women empowerment. The other options are incorrect: MSP guarantee is related to agricultural marketing, 100 days of employment falls under MGNREGA, and direct employment in public sector units is not part of this mission.

Established in 1972, SAC is distinct from other ISRO centers like Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) in Thiruvananthapuram and U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC) in Bengaluru. The center plays a key role in developing operational space applications for societal and commercial benefits. Other options like Mumbai, Trivandrum, and Bangalore host different ISRO facilities.

question_hi: भारत में, स्पेस अप्लिकेशन सेंटर (Space Application Centre, SAC) कहाँ स्थित है?A. मुंबईB. अहमदाबादC. त्रिवेंद्रमD. बैंगलोर (RRB NTPC Tier I (28/04/2016) Shift 3)
options_hi: A
C
B

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है अहमदाबाद

Explanation:
भारत का स्पेस एप्लीकेशन सेंटर (SAC), ISRO का एक प्रमुख केंद्र है, जो गुजरात के अहमदाबाद में स्थित है। यह केंद्र उपग्रह संचार, रिमोट सेंसिंग, और अंतरिक्ष प्रौद्योगिकी के अनुप्रयोगों पर काम करता है। SAC की स्थापना 1972 में हुई थी और यह ISRO के अन्य केंद्रों जैसे विक्रम साराभाई स्पेस सेंटर (VSSC) तिरुवनंतपुरम और यू आर राव सैटेलाइट सेंटर (URSC) बेंगलुरु से अलग है। SAC मुख्यतः अंतरिक्ष प्रौद्योगिकी के सामाजिक और व्यावसायिक अनुप्रयोगों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है। अन्य विकल्पों में मुंबई, तिरुवनंतपुरम और बेंगलुरु ISRO के अन्य केंद्रों के स्थान हैं।
